label: Every actual root withholds each grounded being, from willed giving, WN and SS (inference)
rule: A root never withholding a grounded being would be fixed toward it by its will, so its end would require it
meaning: Every actual root n is the common GOD_4 root of 0c27f65a, so it has intellect; with one power, its giving is the exercise of a rational power (5c1aba17). Let n ground the actual concretum x and suppose n withholds x at no accessible world where n exists. By (b1), n gives x being at w, so n is fixed toward x (NECESSITATE_5). WN makes x required by n's end; x is not n (a root does not ground itself), so SS denies it. By excluded middle, n withholds x somewhere.
